children: Indonesia's finance ministry will maintain its policy to keep 200 trillion rupiah ($11.27 billion) of the government's reserve fund at state-owned commercial banks until July 2027, a deputy finance minister said on Friday.

The cash placement was a signature policy of former finance minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa, who was sacked this week. Deputy minister Juda Agung made the remarks at a press conference alongside the new finance minister, Suahasil Nazara.
